47 /**
48 * @ingroup arrays_views
49 * @brief A generic multi-dimensional array.
50 *
51 * @details Together with nda::basic_array_view, this class forms the backbone of the **nda** library. It is templated
52 * with the following parameters:
53 *
54 * - `ValueType`: This is the type of the elements stored in the array. Most of the time, this will be a scalar type
55 * like an `int`, `double` or `std::complex<double>`, but it can also be a more complex type like a custom class or a
56 * another nda::basic_array.
57 * - `Rank`: Integer specifying the number of dimensions of the array. This is a compile-time constant.
58 * - `LayoutPolicy`: The layout policy specifies how the array views the memory it uses and how it accesses its
59 * elements. It provides a mapping from multi-dimensional to linear indices and vice versa (see @ref layout_pols).
60 * - `Algebra`: The algebra specifies how an array behaves when it is used in an expression. Possible values are 'A'
61 * (array), 'M' (matrix) and 'V' (vector) (see nda::get_algebra).
62 * - `ContainerPolicy`: The container policy specifies how and where the data is stored. It is responsible for
63 * allocating/deallocating the memory (see @ref mem_handles).
64 *
65 * In contrast to views (see nda::basic_array_view), regular arrays own the memory they use for data storage.
66 *
67 * @include doc_basic_array.cpp
68 *
69 * Output:
70 *
71 * ```
72 *
73 * [[1,1]
74 * [1,1]
75 * [1,1]]
76 *
77 * [[42,42]
78 * [1,1]
79 * [1,1]]
80 * ```
81 *
82 * Arrays and views share a lot of the same operations and functionalities. To turn a view into a regular array, use
83 * nda::make_regular.
84 *
85 * @tparam ValueType Type stored in the array.
86 * @tparam Rank Number of dimensions of the array.
87 * @tparam LayoutPolicy Policy determining the memory layout.
88 * @tparam Algebra Algebra of the array.
89 * @tparam ContainerPolicy Policy determining how and where the data is stored.
90 */
91 template <typename ValueType, int Rank, typename LayoutPolicy, char Algebra, typename ContainerPolicy>
92 class basic_array {
93 // Compile-time checks.
94 static_assert(!std::is_const_v<ValueType>, "Error in nda::basic_array: ValueType cannot be const");
95 static_assert((Algebra != 'N'), "Internal error in nda::basic_array: Algebra 'N' not supported");
96 static_assert((Algebra != 'M') or (Rank == 2), "Internal error in nda::basic_array: Algebra 'M' requires a rank 2 array");
97 static_assert((Algebra != 'V') or (Rank == 1), "Internal error in nda::basic_array: Algebra 'V' requires a rank 1 array");
98
99 public:
100 /// Type of the values in the array (can not be const).
101 using value_type = ValueType;
102
103 /// Type of the memory layout policy (see @ref layout_pols).
104 using layout_policy_t = LayoutPolicy;
105
106 /// Type of the memory layout (an nda::idx_map).
107 using layout_t = typename LayoutPolicy::template mapping<Rank>;
108
109 /// Type of the container policy (see @ref mem_pols).
110 using container_policy_t = ContainerPolicy;
111
112 /// Type of the memory handle (see @ref mem_handles).
113 using storage_t = typename ContainerPolicy::template handle<ValueType>;
114
115 /// The associated regular type.
116 using regular_type = basic_array;
117
118 /// Number of dimensions of the array.
119 static constexpr int rank = Rank;
120
121 // Compile-time check.
122 static_assert(has_contiguous(layout_t::layout_prop), "Error in nda::basic_array: Memory layout has to be contiguous");
123 static_assert(not mem::have_device_compatible_addr_space<storage_t> or nda::have_device,
124 "Error in nda::basic_array: Device compatible address space requires compiling with device support.");
125
126 private:
127 // Type of the array itself.
128 using self_t = basic_array;
129
130 // Type of the accessor policy for views (no no_alias_accessor).
131 using AccessorPolicy = default_accessor;
132
133 // Type of the owning policy for views.
134 using OwningPolicy = borrowed<storage_t::address_space>;
135
136 // Constexpr variable that is true if the value_type is const (never for basic_array).
137 static constexpr bool is_const = false;
138
139 // Constexpr variable that is true if the array is a view (never for basic_array).
140 static constexpr bool is_view = false;
141
142 // Memory layout of the array, i.e. the nda::idx_map.
143 layout_t lay;
144
145 // Memory handle of the array.
146 storage_t sto;
147
148 // Construct an array with a given shape and initialize the memory with zeros.
149 template <std::integral Int = long>
150 5416 basic_array(std::array<Int, Rank> const &shape, mem::init_zero_t) : lay{shape}, sto{lay.size(), mem::init_zero} {}
151
152 public:
153 /**
154 * @brief Convert the current array to a view with an 'A' (array) algebra.
155 * @return An nda::basic_array_view of the current array.
156 */
157 13 auto as_array_view() { return basic_array_view<ValueType, Rank, LayoutPolicy, 'A', AccessorPolicy, OwningPolicy>{*this}; };
158
159 /**
160 * @brief Convert the current array to a view with an 'A' (array) algebra.
161 * @return An nda::basic_array_view of the current array with const value type.
162 */
163 auto as_array_view() const { return basic_array_view<const ValueType, Rank, LayoutPolicy, 'A', AccessorPolicy, OwningPolicy>{*this}; };

173 [[deprecated]] auto transpose() const

175 {
176 return permuted_indices_view<encode(std::array<int, 2>{1, 0})>(*this);
177 }

179 /// Default constructor constructs an empty array with a default constructed memory handle and layout.
180 5799 basic_array() {}; // NOLINT (user-defined constructor to avoid value initialization of the sso buffer)
181
182 /// Default move constructor moves the memory handle and layout.
183 9872 basic_array(basic_array &&) = default;

185 /// Default copy constructor copies the memory handle and layout.
186 5526 explicit basic_array(basic_array const &a) = default;

188 /**
189 * @brief Construct an array from another array with a different algebra and/or container policy.
190 *
191 * @details It takes the memory layout of the other array and copies the data from the memory handle.

193 * @tparam A Algebra of the other array.

196 */
197 template <char A, typename CP>
198 358 explicit basic_array(basic_array<ValueType, Rank, LayoutPolicy, A, CP> a) noexcept : lay(a.indexmap()), sto(std::move(a.storage())) {}
